overall_notes: This paper focuses on query-focused multi-document summarization using a coarse-to-fine approach with BERT-based evidence estimation. The extraction was generally accurate but included some training datasets that weren't used for NLG evaluation. The paper uses traditional evaluation methods (ROUGE + human evaluation) without LLM judges. Human evaluation was well-documented with clear criteria and methodology.
